name: member-lookup
description: Scripted discovery of member-lookup on mock-bank: sign on, search {{memberId}}, read the Share Savings balance and the member name. Placeholders only; the agent substitutes the example inputs and credentials.

input.reason: Enter the operator user ID on the Sign On form.
Enter the member number on Member Search.

input.name: savingsBalance
input.reason: The goal asks for the Share Savings balance.
Read the balance next to Share Savings on Member Inquiry.

input.name: memberName
input.description: The member's name as shown on Member Inquiry.
input.reason: Return the member name to confirm the right record.
Read the member name on Member Inquiry.

input.summary: Signed on, found member {{memberId}} and read the Share Savings balance and member name.
input.reason: Member Inquiry is shown and both outputs are extracted.
